instructions.question: Which row of `screen.rows` is the on-screen element that `intent` refers to?
instructions.screen: `screen.rows` lists the elements as `key | role | name | state | region`; `screen.texts` is the visible text.
instructions.none: Answer `none` when no row is the element that `intent` refers to (for example, it is not on this screen).
